This gap won’t be filled just by increasing the cross-border mobility of skilled people. European
startups urgently need more talent in absolute terms. For that, we need an inclusive ecosystem,
which embodies ideals that attract an increasing number of different kinds of people.
Notably, many of our interviewees alluded to the fact that the discussion around diversity tends to
